metadata.question: Did the land area of Great Fox Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Landsat L2 SR: LT05 (1999), LC08 (2019), fallback to LE07 if needed.
- Date windows: primary Jun–Sep; fallback Apr–Oct.
- Geometry: point near Great Fox Island, Chesapeake Bay, buffered 2 km to encompass the island(s) but minimize mainland.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds, cloud shadows, snow using QA_PIXEL bits (1,2,3,4,5).
- Build median composites for each period, then compute MNDWI on scaled reflectance and classify water vs. land.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections are empty after fallbacks: C1.
- If composite produces 0 valid pixels in ROI after masking: C2.
- If area calculation returns null/NaN or out-of-range: C3.
- Else compare land areas; if 2019 < 1999 by at least max(1% of 1999, 0.5 ha): A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-75.865, 37.89]); // Great Fox Island vicinity (Tangier Sound, Chesapeake Bay)
  const roi = center.buffer(2000); // 2 km buffer to encompass island/group
  const roiAreaHa = ee.Number(roi.area(1)).divide(1e4);

  // Helpers: QA mask, scale, MNDWI
  function maskL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));     // snow
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function applyScale(img) {
    const scaled = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }

  function addMNDWI(img, sensor) {
    const green = (sensor === 'L8' || sensor === 'L9') ? 'SR_B3' : 'SR_B2';
    const swir1 = (sensor === 'L8' || sensor === 'L9') ? 'SR_B6' : 'SR_B5';
    const mndwi = img.normalizedDifference([green, swir1]).rename('mndwi');
    return img.addBands(mndwi);
  }

  async function buildComposite(year) {
    // Try sequences for sensors/dates with fallbacks
    const trials = [];
    function pushTrial(collId, sensor, start, end) {
      trials.push({ collId, sensor, start, end });
    }
    const y = year.toString();
    // Primary windows: Jun–Sep, fallback Apr–Oct
    const primaryStart = `${y}-06-01`;
    const primaryEnd   = `${y}-09-30`;
    const wideStart    = `${y}-04-01`;
    const wideEnd      = `${y}-10-31`;

    if (year >= 2013) {
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', 'L8', primaryStart, primaryEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', 'L8', wideStart, wideEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', 'L7', primaryStart, primaryEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', 'L7', wideStart, wideEnd);
    } else {
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'L5', primaryStart, primaryEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'L5', wideStart, wideEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', 'L7', primaryStart, primaryEnd);
      pushTrial('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', 'L7', wideStart, wideEnd);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < trials.length; i++) {
      const t = trials[i];
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(t.collId)
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(t.start, t.end)
        .map(maskL2)
        .map(applyScale);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size > 0) {
        const med = col.median();
        const img = addMNDWI(med, t.sensor).set({
          'year': year,
          'sensor': t.sensor,
          'imgCount': size,
          'window': `${t.start} to ${t.end}`
        });
        return img;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function computeStats(composite) {
    const year = composite.get('year');
    const sensor = composite.get('sensor');
    const imgCount = composite.get('imgCount');
    const window = composite.get('window');

    const mndwi = composite.select('mndwi');
    const water = mndwi.gt(0);
    const land = water.not().rename('land');

    // Valid pixel count and unmasked area fraction (30 m for accuracy in small ROI)
    const validPx = await mndwi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).get('mndwi').getInfo();

    // Unmasked area (m2)
    const unmaskedArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(mndwi.mask()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).get('area').getInfo();

    const roiAreaHaVal = await roiAreaHa.getInfo();
    const unmaskedHa = (unmaskedArea || 0) / 1e4;
    const unmaskedPct = roiAreaHaVal > 0 ? (100 * unmaskedHa / roiAreaHaVal) : null;

    // Land area (ha)
    const landAreaM2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(land).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).get('area').getInfo();

    const landHa = landAreaM2 ? landAreaM2 / 1e4 : 0;

    return {
      year: await year.getInfo(),
      sensor: await sensor.getInfo(),
      imgCount: await imgCount.getInfo(),
      window: await window.getInfo(),
      validPx: validPx || 0,
      unmaskedPct: unmaskedPct !== null ? unmaskedPct : null,
      landHa: landHa
    };
  }

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  const comp1999 = await buildComposite(1999);
  const comp2019 = await buildComposite(2019);

  if (comp1999 === null || comp2019 === null) {
    if (comp1999 === null) console.log('1999 Images: 0');
    if (comp2019 === null) console.log('2019 Images: 0');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  // 3. Processing and validation (pixel counts, unmasked %)
  const s1999 = await computeStats(comp1999);
  const s2019 = await computeStats(comp2019);

  if ((s1999.validPx || 0) === 0 || (s2019.validPx || 0) === 0) {
    console.log(`1999 Images: ${s1999.imgCount}, Valid px: ${s1999.validPx}`);
    console.log(`2019 Images: ${s2019.imgCount}, Valid px: ${s2019.validPx}`);
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Calculation and sanity checks
  const roiHa = await roiAreaHa.getInfo();
  function invalid(val) {
    return val === null || isNaN(val) || !isFinite(val) || val < 0 || val > (roiHa + 1); // +1 ha tolerance
  }
  if (invalid(s1999.landHa) || invalid(s2019.landHa)) {
    console.log(`1999 Land ha: ${s1999.landHa}, 2019 Land ha: ${s2019.landHa}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // Print concise evidence
  const unmasked99 = s1999.unmaskedPct !== null ? s1999.unmaskedPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA';
  const unmasked19 = s2019.unmaskedPct !== null ? s2019.unmaskedPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA';
  console.log(`1999 Images: ${s1999.imgCount} (${s1999.window}), Valid px: ${s1999.validPx}, Unmasked%: ${unmasked99}, Land ha: ${s1999.landHa.toFixed(2)}`);
  console.log(`2019 Images: ${s2019.imgCount} (${s2019.window}), Valid px: ${s2019.validPx}, Unmasked%: ${unmasked19}, Land ha: ${s2019.landHa.toFixed(2)}`);

  const changeHa = s2019.landHa - s1999.landHa;
  const changePct = s1999.landHa > 0 ? (100 * changeHa / s1999.landHa) : null;
  const changePctStr = changePct !== null && isFinite(changePct) ? changePct.toFixed(1) : 'NA';
  console.log(`Change ha (2019-1999): ${changeHa.toFixed(2)} (${changePctStr}%)`);

  // 5. Final Answer
  const thresholdHa = Math.max(0.5, 0.01 * s1999.landHa);
  const decreased = (s2019.landHa < (s1999.landHa - thresholdHa));
  console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
